results.title: Falling
results.overview: Alone in the suffocating quiet of his surrogate sister’s apartment, fifteen-year-old Analu clings desperately to memories of his lost loved one, Iolani, the one person who made him feel seen. The night becomes a battleground of haunting flashbacks and quiet suffering, as Analu teeters between holding on and letting go. Malu, his surrogate sister, fights to reach the part of him still holding on. Falling is a raw, intimate journey through trauma, where the weight of the past threatens to eclipse the connections that remain.

results.title: Where Is Your Faith
results.overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

results.title: The Future Is in Your Hands, But Why Not Lend It to the Specialists?
results.original_title: Viitorul ți-l faci cu mâna ta, dar de ce să nu îl lași pe mâna unor specialiști?
results.overview: Influenced by the media and current beauty standards, Beatrice undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries, under the watchful eye of her husband.

results.title: Cena di classe
results.overview: A group of former high school classmates reunite after seventeen years for the funeral of an old friend. Aided by alcohol and a forgotten video, they sneak into their old school one night to relive the magic of that time. But a simple reunion quickly turns into a criminal adventure.

results.title: Sister
results.overview: Desperate to raise money for her younger sister's surgery, Hae-ran teams up with Tae-soo to kidnap her half-sister So-jin. So-jin wakes up confined in an unfamiliar place. Hae-ran and Tae-soo demand a hefty ransom, expecting her wealthy father to cough up the money. Upon discovering that one of her captors is her half-sister, So-jin enters a precarious alliance that blurs the lines between victim and perpetrator as she plots a counterattack against the ruthless Tae-soo.

results.original_title: Joy Division: Plan K, Brussels 16th October, 1979
results.overview: The full show previous unreleased till now.

results.title: Interwoven Intervals
results.overview: Interwoven Intervals finds a new form between weaving, drawing, and cinema, intersecting graphic approaches to sound and film materials with the machinic manipulations of textile production, printing, and cinema.

results.title: HUELLAS. Echoes of State Terrorism in Mar del Plata 50 Years On
results.original_title: HUELLAS. A 50 años del golpe en Mar del Plata
results.overview: Can the sea wash everything away? Huellas reconstructs the circuit of state terrorism in Mar del Plata, 50 years after the civic-military coup. Through the testimonies of survivors, family members and specialists, the documentary probes the indelible marks left by repression and the resilience of a community that demands memory. Because history never ends, it is written.

results.title: The Vale - Origins
results.overview: A grieving inventor family finds new life in their collective creativity when they build an AI-generated virtual reality world around their young son’s imagination.

results.title: The Cottage
results.overview: A group of friends (including a banker, a card player, a blogger, and a young director) head out of town and rent a suspiciously cheap dacha, where they are forced to face a mysterious killer and their own dark secrets.

results.title: No One Leaves
results.overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

results.title: JCW Strangle-Mania: Viva Las Violence 2026
results.overview: The "Wicked Clowns" are taking over the Strip for a night of pure, unadulterated violence. Juggalo Championship Wrestling presents Strangle-Mania: Viva Las Violence. Streaming Live and Exclisive on TrillerTV+, this event brings the legendary spirit of the Gathering to Las Vegas for a high-stakes, high-impact spectacle.

results.title: Mız
results.overview: Farid finds himself in a different field while trying to become a screenwriter.

results.title: Gym Rat
results.overview: An ex-con bodybuilder driven by a Mr. Olympia fantasy, unravels as obsession, illegal steroids and a volatile gym boss collide; until love forces him to confront the monster within.

results.title: Dance of the Spirits
results.overview: Matei, a young shepherd boy living in the outskirts of Romania, finds more comfort among his sheep than with his abusive, alcoholic dad. But now Matei is starting to mimic his father's violence, he's faced with a question: 'Who am I?'

results.title: Daydream
results.overview: A young adult recounts childhood memories involving his 6th grade teacher and the lessons she taught, particularly her unconventional assignment: to daydream.

results.title: Starfish
results.overview: A returning son carries the weight of the city and the secrets of how he survived it back to a home suffocated by his father's blind loyalty.
